protocol.page_observation: numbered, enabled and visible form controls in the task area; labels, roles and current product title
protocol.harness: Web port of cua-driver 0.38.0 signature_arc at 360 ms; actual Brave mouse clicks and keyboard input. Fixed harness opens shop after confirmed form and follows View Cart after the add confirmation.
protocol.timer: Warm model, from first form observation through rendered cart row, exact form values, product, and quantity checked. Includes inference, pointer, typing, page navigation and verification; excludes model startup and initial form load.
protocol.evaluation: Six paired variants across the same two page templates, identical instructions per pair and fresh anonymous context. Case index alternates which checkpoint runs first. The edit was selected on a separate development prompt/run.
protocol.video: First successful paired case by numeric order whose slower arm completed within 20 seconds. Both timelines are original 1x video aligned by visual start marker. Finished browser holds on its cart.
